title: Chris' Life Pack
description: A minimalist datapack that makes all of your players have 3 lives
body:
Datapack I made because I wanted to play semihardcore with my friends :) if you want a new feature feel free to suggest it!

Each players start out with 3 lives, if you lose them all your gamemode gets switched to spectator

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cf47bd7d7ec41e29349ecb81d460cd03865a91d.png)

# Features
## Adding
You can add as many lives as you want!
```
/function chrislife:add {player:PLAYER_NAME, number:AMOUNT_LIVES}
```
## Removing
You can also remove as many lives as you want :)
```
/function chrislife:remove {player:PLAYER_NAME, number:AMOUNT_LIVES}
```
## Transfering
If you want to make a player give a life to another one
```
/function chrislife:transfer {player1:PLAYER_THAT_GIVES, player2:PLAYER_THAT_RECIEVES}
```
